query:
SELECT
            COUNT(*)                                              AS "total!: i64",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stock_status = 'low_stock')     AS "low!: i64",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stock_status = 'out_of_stock')  AS "out!: i64"
        FROM products p
        JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id
        WHERE p.farmer_id  = $1
          AND p.is_active   = true
          AND p.is_deleted  = false
